deadline.value: January 15 is the full-consideration date; the Fall 2027 application closes March 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: January 15 – Application deadline | Applications must be received by this date to receive full consideration.

also.quote: The Fall '27 application will open on August 1, 2026 and close on March 1, 2027.

gre_general.value: The chemistry PhD no longer requires GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: GRE Scores are no longer required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE subject test is required for chemistry.
gre_subject.quote: GRE Scores are no longer required.

toefl_min.value: Chemistry requires a TOEFL iBT of at least 80 with speaking above 17, the same base minimum as the graduate school.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score (international students only) iBT min 80 (with speaking >17)

ielts_min.value: Chemistry accepts an IELTS overall band of 6.5 or higher.

funding.value: Nearly all entering full-time PhD students receive a teaching assistantship with a 12-month stipend, and a University Graduate Scholarship pays tuition.
funding.quote: Nearly all entering full-time graduate students receive a graduate teaching assistantship (TA), which provides a 12-month stipend for living costs.

also.quote: In addition, these full-time graduate students in our program are awarded a University Graduate Scholarship which pays for tuition.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether applicants come directly from a bachelor's or need a master's.

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor rule.

notes: Deadline January 15 for full consideration; the Fall application closes March 1 each year, and the 2027 close is March 1, 2027.
